Adobe Learning Manager Pricing

Quote-only enterprise platform. Formerly Adobe Captivate Prime. Sold inside Adobe Experience Cloud for enterprise customers.

What is published, and what is not

Adobe does not publish a Learning Manager rate. The dedicated pricing page did not respond at last verification, and the product is positioned as an Adobe Experience Cloud component. This site does not infer a rate. To get an Adobe quote, contact Adobe Enterprise sales.

What Adobe sells

The product, and the rename

Adobe Learning Manager is the rebranded version of Adobe Captivate Prime. The naming change was part of Adobe’s broader Experience Cloud consolidation. It is paired with Adobe Captivate (the authoring tool), so organisations already producing eLearning content with Captivate get a natural delivery target.

When this fits

Buyer profile

  • You are already an Adobe Experience Cloud customer (AEM, Marketo, Workfront).
  • You produce eLearning content with Adobe Captivate and want a tightly integrated delivery surface.
  • You need to deliver to internal employees, external partners, or customers from a single platform.
When this does not fit

Reasons to look elsewhere

  • You are not on Adobe Experience Cloud. Standalone procurement is not a published path.
  • You want a fast SMB or mid-market path with published per-user pricing.
  • You need a free trial to evaluate before talking to sales.
